chain.title: Find a Meal You Can Actually Make
chain.desc: Obtain the Cooking for Blockheads recipe book and inspect food recipes available from your ingredients. Its recipe list helps you turn the food available in this pack into practical meals.

chain.title: Cook from the Book
chain.desc: Upgrade to the crafting-capable book and make a supported meal. Keep the required ingredients and containers available.

chain.title: Build the Kitchen's Center
chain.desc: Place a Cooking Table as the interface for a connected kitchen. It draws on supported connected components to find ingredients and tools.

chain.title: Keep Ingredients Within Reach
chain.desc: Add a connected Kitchen Counter and stock it with food ingredients. Verify they appear in the Cooking Table's available recipe choices.

chain.title: Another Place for the Pantry
chain.desc: Connect a Fridge and fill it with ingredients. Its storage becomes part of the kitchen network when the arrangement is connected correctly.

chain.title: Supply Water to the Kitchen
chain.desc: Add a connected Sink and test a recipe that needs water. Water-source behavior can be configured by the pack.

chain.title: Cook the Ingredients the Kitchen Needs
chain.desc: Connect an Oven, supply its required fuel and queue suitable food. Check the output and available ingredients before expecting a multi-stage meal to finish.

chain.title: Keep Cooking Tools Available
chain.desc: Place a Tool Rack in the connected kitchen and store supported cooking tools. Recipe compatibility depends on the food mods installed.

chain.title: A Place for Kitchen Milk
chain.desc: Add a Milk Jar and fill it according to the mod's interaction. Test that the kitchen can use it in a supported recipe.

chain.title: A Renewable Milk Upgrade
chain.desc: Follow the mod's cow-and-anvil interaction to create a Cow in a Jar. Connect it to the kitchen for a renewable milk supply.

chain.title: A Different Way to Power the Oven
chain.desc: Install a Heating Unit and provide the required energy connection. This is an optional power branch; an ordinary fueled oven remains useful.

chain.title: Cook from the Whole Kitchen
chain.desc: Stock connected storage, provide water and cooking fuel, then make a meal through the Cooking Table. Confirm after the kitchen uses its shared supplies successfully.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: A connected kitchen with shared ingredient storage, water, cooking and real meal production.
coverage.limitations: Recipe quantities, enabled content and progression settings may be changed by the installed pack.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
